On section start, parse the reported total defensively and only construct pace(total) when total is a positive finite number; otherwise leave pacebar null, still print the section description, and treat the section as a no-progress-bar section. On section status, ignore or clamp invalid current counts and only call pacebar.op when a bar exists. On section end, only finish/update/end the pace charm when pacebar exists; for no-bar sections still print completion notices and reset hasExceededOrReachedTotal/currentTotal/hasCommentLine state. Avoid calling pace(0) or pace(undefined), and preserve the final searchBuild.buildSearchIndex callback behavior.
validation_evidence: node chapman.js index --verbose no longer throws pace error: You MUST specify the total number of operations that will be processed.
Empty datastore sections still print their descriptions/completion notices and the CLI exits instead of hanging.
No source files outside the approved chapman/Search/directdb failure path are required for this repair.

planning_notes: Loaded impact-report.json as authoritative. Inspected only reported source ranges plus minimal surrounding context for high-risk startup, MongoDB, Solr, logging, metrics, media, utility, and admin UI loader files; package manifests were read in full because their dependency blocks are the affected ranges. No lockfiles were found, so dependency setup is planned with npm.cmd install --no-audit --no-fund in each module whose manifest changes before user-supplied checks. User startup commands were converted into bounded PowerShell wrappers that start node app.js, poll the supplied browser-renderable URLs http://localhost:8080/ and http://localhost:8082/, and kill the process. CLI commands are represented exactly and required=true. Solr runtime target is still an unknown external-service gap; official Solr references indicate Trie fields are deprecated as of Solr 7 and Solr 9 requires broader upgrade review, so this plan targets Solr 9.x-compatible schema/config only if the deployed Solr runtime is upgraded accordingly. Admin Ember is intentionally capped at Ember 1.13.x patch-level assets without ember-cli; migrating ObjectController, Ember.View, Ember.Handlebars helpers, and Ember.Set to later Ember requires a separate full Ember/ember-cli migration and is not authorized here. Vendored browser library replacement files are included because the ImpactReport dependency graph names them as version sources; their minified internals were not inspected. Scope expansion limit is 3 and only permits files outside planned_files that fail a bounded startup/CLI check due to direct calls into dependencies listed in expected_dependency_changes for the same major bump. Continuation revision after Stage 4 failure: the previously consumed scope expansions are now explicitly approved and planned (tv-radio-admin/Admin/API/admin-usage.js for influx, tv-radio-frontend/content/tv-radio/client-tv-radio.js for Express 5 wildcard routes, and tv-radio-frontend/content/unisat/client-unisat.js for Express 5 wildcard routes). Added tv-radio-frontend/content/public-viewer/client-public-viewer.js for the newly approved Express 5 /public/viewer/* startup failure at line 30. For this continuation only, validation.scope_expansion_limit is reduced to 2 and is limited to additional direct dependency breakages discovered by the existing executor checks; it does not authorize unrelated refactors, new dependency upgrades, or source edits outside direct failures of dependencies already listed in expected_dependency_changes. Chapman index continuation revision: the chapman index failure path is now approved because it is directly caused by upgraded async/pace/MongoDB behavior under the required empty-datastore CLI smoke command node chapman.js index --verbose. The approved narrow path covers tv-radio-admin/CLI/chapman.js progress handling for zero/empty totals, tv-radio-admin/Search/build.js async 3 single-shot count callbacks and empty datastore section completion, and tv-radio-admin/Common/directdb-mongo.js promise-to-callback single-callback repair; it does not authorize unrelated source edits or additional dependency upgrades.
plan_summary: Plan covers all 44 ImpactReport affected files plus five vendored browser asset replacements and the approved chapman index smoke failure path and the approved chapman index smoke failure path and the approved chapman index smoke failure path from the ImpactReport dependency graph. It upgrades major-gap npm dependencies across every package.json, preserves callback/CommonJS module boundaries, keeps Socket.IO server/client on major 4 lockstep, caps admin Ember at non-ember-cli 1.13.x compatibility, and declares bounded validation for setup, syntax checks, two startup probes, and four required CLI smoke commands.
